key.name: language
key.summary: Notchy's interface language: auto follows the system language; de or en apply to Notchy only

key.name: style
key.summary: Dynamic Glass (black notch fading into glass) or Liquid Glass (floating glass capsule)

key.name: glass-level
key.summary: Share of the opened Dynamic Glass surface that is black before it fades into glass; 100 is entirely black

key.name: width
key.summary: Expanded width

key.name: hover-open
key.summary: Expand on hover

key.name: hover-delay
key.summary: Hover delay

key.name: collapse-delay
key.summary: Collapse delay

key.name: animation-duration
key.summary: Animation duration

key.name: clock-opens-notchy
key.summary: Integrated clock opens the Kalender tab instead of GNOME's calendar popup

key.name: scroll-volume
key.summary: Scrolling over the closed island changes the output volume

key.name: hide-fullscreen
key.summary: Hide over fullscreen apps

key.name: clipboard-enabled
key.summary: Record clipboard history

key.name: clipboard-limit
key.summary: Clipboard history limit

key.name: clipboard-persist
key.summary: Save clipboard across sessions

key.name: clipboard-retention-days
key.summary: Clipboard retention

key.name: exclude-apps
key.summary: Apps excluded from clipboard recording

key.name: media-enabled
key.summary: Media controls

key.name: media-waveform
key.summary: Visualize output-monitor audio while playing

key.name: airplay-enabled
key.summary: Discover AirPlay receivers on the local network as audio outputs

key.name: airdrop-enabled
key.summary: Offer AirDrop when the airdrop-mt7921 backend is installed

key.name: airdrop-daemon
key.summary: Path to airdropd (empty = look for an installed airdrop-mt7921)

key.name: airdrop-folder
key.summary: Folder for files received over AirDrop (empty = Downloads/AirDrop)

key.name: hud-enabled
key.summary: Volume and brightness as island live activity

key.name: notifications-enabled
key.summary: Notification live activities

key.name: snap-enabled
key.summary: Offer snap layouts when a window is dragged into the notch

key.name: jiggle-enabled
key.summary: Summon basket by jiggling during a file drag

key.name: drag-summon
key.summary: Show drop area when dragging over island

key.name: preferred-player
key.summary: Preferred MPRIS player bus name

key.name: launcher-file-search
key.summary: Thunderstorm searches files and folders through GNOME LocalSearch (or a bounded crawl of the personal folders without it)

key.name: launcher-max-results
key.summary: Visible Thunderstorm results before the list scrolls

key.name: launcher-quicklinks
key.summary: Thunderstorm quicklinks as JSON: keyword, name, url (http/https template with {query} or {path}, xdg:NAME, a folder path or app:ID.desktop); empty means the built-in defaults for the interface language

key.name: launcher-snippets
key.summary: Thunderstorm text snippets as JSON: name, keyword, text ({date}, {time}, {datetime}); empty means the built-in defaults for the interface language

key.name: launcher-web-search
key.summary: Web search template for Thunderstorm's fallback row

key.name: launcher-commands
key.summary: Thunderstorm's built-in commands as JSON, one override per command id: enabled, visible, aliases, favorite, priority (-2 to 2), shortcut; missing means the default. Confirmations cannot be turned off

key.name: launcher-extra-folders
key.summary: Additional folders for the simple file search when LocalSearch is not running

key.name: airpods-enabled
key.summary: AirPods integration (through the airpods-helper daemon, or BlueZ for basic status)

key.name: airpods-animation
key.summary: Show a short connection animation with the battery levels when AirPods connect

key.name: airpods-battery-warning
key.summary: Warn in the island when an AirPod or the case runs low

key.name: airpods-battery-threshold
key.summary: Battery level in percent below which the island warns

key.name: airpods-bubble
key.summary: Show connected AirPods as a small symbol with a battery ring beside the notch; a click opens their controls

key.name: airpods-builtin
key.summary: Without airpods-helper, read connected AirPods over Apple's accessory protocol (AAP) directly: batteries, ear state, noise control

key.name: airpods-ear-pause
key.summary: With the built-in reader: pause media when a bud is taken out, resume when it is back

key.name: airpods-bluez-fallback
key.summary: Without airpods-helper, show connection and battery of Apple headphones reported by BlueZ

key.name: agents-enabled
key.summary: Show AI agent sessions (Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, notchyctl, MCP) as indicators beside the notch

key.name: agents-claude
key.summary: Show Claude Code sessions (from its hooks)

key.name: agents-codex
key.summary: Show Codex sessions (from its hooks)

key.name: agents-antigravity
key.summary: Show Google Antigravity sessions (from its hooks)

key.name: agents-auto-layout
key.summary: Distribute indicators beside the notch automatically between left and right

key.name: agents-side
key.summary: Preferred side per agent provider as JSON, e.g. {"claude": "left"}; missing or "auto" means automatic

key.name: agents-show-idle
key.summary: Show agents that are ready but have no task

key.name: agents-completion-animation
key.summary: Play a short animation when an agent finishes a task

key.name: agents-completed-seconds
key.summary: How long a finished task is shown as completed before the agent counts as idle

key.name: toggle-search
key.summary: Thunderstorm search in the island

key.name: toggle-island
key.summary: Toggle island

key.name: toggle-clipboard
key.summary: Open clipboard

key.name: toggle-basket
key.summary: Open floating basket

key.name: toggle-ring
key.summary: Open radial capture menu
